landing.heroTitle: Transform Learning Into an Immersive Digital Experience.
landing.heroCopy: A premium learning management platform for courses, students, instructors, payments, certificates, and interactive learning journeys.
landing.statsCopy: Join a growing community of students, instructors, and institutions building the future of education.
landing.featuresTitle: Everything a modern LMS needs, without backend bloat.
landing.featuresCopy: Secure learning journeys, elegant dashboards, and bilingual experiences built into the core foundation.
landing.featureCourseCopy: Create, manage, and publish courses with structured content and progress tracking.
landing.featureVideoCopy: DRM-aware video playback that protects premium content while delivering smooth experiences.
landing.featureDashboardCopy: Personalized progress tracking, enrolled courses, and achievement overviews.
landing.featureInstructorCopy: Full course builder, student management, submissions review, and analytics.
landing.featureActivationCopy: Generate and redeem activation codes for course access and promotions.
landing.featureQuizCopy: Create quizzes and assignments with scoring, attempts, and structured feedback.
landing.featureCertCopy: Auto-generated, verifiable certificates upon course completion with unique credentials.
landing.featurePaymentCopy: Manual payment processing with proof upload, review, and activation workflows.
landing.featureAnalyticsCopy: Insights into student engagement, revenue trends, and course performance metrics.
landing.featureI18nCopy: Full Arabic and English support with RTL layout, bilingual content, and seamless switching.
landing.featureMessagingCopy: Direct instructor-student communication for questions, feedback, and discussions.
landing.howTitle: A learning flow that feels effortless.
landing.howCopy: From signup to certification, every step is designed for clarity and progress.
landing.stepCreateCopy: Sign up and set up your student profile in seconds.
landing.stepActivateCopy: Redeem an activation code or enroll directly into your chosen course.
landing.stepLearnCopy: Progress through protected video lessons at your own pace.
landing.stepQuizCopy: Test your understanding with structured quizzes and assignments.
landing.stepSubmitCopy: Upload your work and receive instructor feedback and grades.
landing.stepCertCopy: Receive a verifiable digital certificate upon course completion.
landing.previewTitle: Sample experiences your learners will love.
landing.previewCopy: Course cards showcase the quality and depth of each learning journey.
landing.dashboardCopy: See how students, instructors, and admins each get a tailored experience.
landing.testimonialsTitle: Trusted by ambitious learners and fast-moving teams.
landing.pricingTitle: Launch with the right plan for every stage.
landing.pricingCopy: From individual learners to large institutions, there's a plan that fits.
landing.ctaTitle: Ready to transform your learning experience?
landing.ctaCopy: Join thousands of students and instructors already using our platform to achieve their goals.
landing.cameraPrivacyNote: Camera runs locally in your browser. No video is stored or uploaded.

auth.loginCopy: Sign in to continue your protected learning journey.
auth.registerCopy: Your profile is created client-side in Firestore with a student role by default.
auth.forgotCopy: Enter your email and we will send you a reset link.
auth.activationCopy: Enter your activation code to access your courses.
auth.terms: I agree to the platform terms and privacy policy.

forms.passwordMin: Password must be at least 6 characters
